name: Skin Disease Classification Dataset (9,548 Dermatoscopic Images)
description: A self-collected clinical dermatoscopic image dataset comprising 9,548 images across five dermatological conditions: Acne (1,148 images), Vitiligo (2,016 images), Hyperpigmentation (700 images), Nail Psoriasis (2,520 images), and SJS-TEN (3,164 images). Collected from hospitals and clinical resources to train deep learning models on less common non-melanoma skin conditions. Safeguard notice: For machine learning research only; not validated for clinical diagnosis.
